51.text: Suddenly, I felt a tap on the shoulder. I turned around to see Daria de Rava.
51.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Sazon"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Suspicion"] > 2)

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "Baroness de Rava. How is your family?"

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "Who dares tap the shoulder of the King of Rizia?"

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "Now is not a good time. I'm really quite tired."

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "Madam Speaker. Just the person I've been looking to talk to."

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "Ah, the leader of the RNC. Just the person I've been looking to talk to."

63.speaker: Daria de Rava
63.text: "I only need a minute, Your Majesty. It's rather important."

65.speaker: Daria de Rava
65.text: "I didn't realize hierarchies were so important to you, Your Majesty."

66.speaker: Daria de Rava
66.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. It's been a spectacular evening."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "If you insist. Let's go to the trophy room."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "Anything you have to say to me, you can safely say to the other guests gathered in this room."

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: She gave me a look of warning.

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "My apologies, but I have other people to talk to. Have a good evening."

71.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
71.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Sazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Sazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Suspicion"] > 2) == false)

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: My mother walked over to stand next to me.

73.speaker: Estela Toras
73.text: "A little premature to be kicking our guests out, isn't it, darling?"
73.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Sazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Monqiz_PartyPrince"] == true) == false)

76.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Sazon"] == true) == false

80.speaker: Estela Toras
80.text: "Your cousin Hubertus looks like he's just itching to speak with you."

87.speaker: Estela Toras
87.text: "What will your wife say if she finds out you never greeted your in-laws?"
87.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true)

88.speaker: Estela Toras
88.text: "House Azaro didn't come all this way just for the appetizers, you know."
88.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false)

92.speaker: Estela Toras
92.text: "Poor Leona Sazon came all by herself. She could use someone to talk to."
92.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == false)

93.speaker: Estela Toras
93.text: "The Sazons are off in the corner with no one to talk to. You could at least exchange a few words."
93.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Toras"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.HouseGathering_Default_Conversation_Azaro"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == false) == false)

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "I don't care. These functions are torture."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "Fine, you win. One more round of glad-handing it is."

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "I'll embarrass myself if I keep running my mouth off to everyone. Better to remain a monarch of mystery."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Have you seen what's happening outside? I can't keep making small talk while the kingdom is in crisis."

106.speaker: Estela Toras
106.text: "One more transparently insincere attempt at flattery, and I would've gone to hide in the toilet."

110.speaker: Estela Toras
110.text: "I couldn't bear to listen to one more backhanded comment about your... special status."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "All your worries were overblown. Our relatives accept me exactly as I am."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "I suppose it was rude of me to turn your big day into my coming-out party."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "You were right. Rizia wasn't ready for a same-sex partnership on the throne."

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: Daria took a long look at me, then bowed.

116.speaker: Daria de Rava
116.text: "You too, Your Majesty. All my best to the Queen Mother."

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: She walked away to talk to one of the other nobles.

120.speaker: Daria de Rava
120.text: "That isn't true, and you know it."

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: She gave a terse nod and motioned for me to follow her.

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: We walked into the trophy room, and I shut the door behind us.

123.speaker: Narrator
123.text: Daria stood stock-still as she spoke.

124.speaker: Daria de Rava
124.text: "Your Majesty... speaking to the other guests at this gathering, I've gotten the impression that certain suspicions have begun to circulate."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "If you're referring to my orientation, you must know that's no longer a secret."

131.speaker: Player_Romus
131.text: "Who have you been talking to? Tell me, and I'll have them beheaded on the spot."

134.speaker: Daria de Rava
134.text: "That's not what I'm referring to. Though it's also one of tonight's hotly discussed topics..."

135.speaker: Daria de Rava
135.text: "I'll be blunt. The RNC may not be the majority in the House of Delegates anymore, but it is still a slap in the face to attempt reforms without consulting me or my party."

140.speaker: Daria de Rava
140.text: "I'll be blunt. The RNC still constitutes a majority in the House of Delegates. You can't simply attempt reforms without consulting me or my party."

141.speaker: Player_Romus
141.text: "What are you talking about? I have no intention of attempting reforms."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "I can and I will. It's too late for you or anyone else in the RNC to stop me."

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "You and your party have been against reforms from day one. Why would I consult you?"

144.speaker: Player_Romus
144.text: "Watch what you say. You wouldn't want to end this perfectly lovely evening in a prison cell."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "The RNC is no longer relevant. I'm acting according to the wishes of the real people of Rizia."

146.speaker: Daria de Rava
146.text: "The nobility is real enough, Your Majesty. And from what's being said out there, they pose a danger."

147.speaker: Daria de Rava
147.text: "That would only give more ammunition to the people out there who want to overthrow you."

148.speaker: Daria de Rava
148.text: "We don't have time for games, Your Majesty."

149.speaker: Daria de Rava
149.text: "Because we're the only buffer between you and those in this room who would overthrow you."

150.speaker: Daria de Rava
150.text: "What about the nobility, Your Majesty? There's a reason you've been keeping your intentions a secret."

151.speaker: Daria de Rava
151.text: "If you want, the RNC and I can run interference. Prevent your would-be usurpers from finding out your true plans until it's too late."

152.speaker: Player_Romus
152.text: "Once and for all, what plans? The people you're talking to are spreading lies about me behind my back."

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "There's no need, Ms. de Rava. The other houses wouldn't dare go against my plans, anyway."

154.speaker: Player_Romus
154.text: "And what would you want in exchange for this act of kindness?"

155.speaker: Narrator
155.text: The corners of her lips turned up.

156.speaker: Daria de Rava
156.text: "All I want is to keep my job, Your Majesty."

160.speaker: Daria de Rava
160.text: "I only want a small promotion, Your Majesty."

164.speaker: Daria de Rava
164.text: "If you want, the RNC and I can run interference. Prevent your would-be usurpers from finding out your true plans until it's too late."

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "If you were to do so, I would make sure you were duly rewarded."

166.speaker: Daria de Rava
166.text: "And I, in turn, would not let that reward go to waste."

167.speaker: Daria de Rava
167.text: "Allow me to oversee the coming transition. Appoint me as prime minister."

168.speaker: Daria de Rava
168.text: "As majority leader of the House of Delegates, I should be the one to oversee the coming transition. As Prime Minister."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "The reform movement leader is Adarfo Sotelato. He must be the one to shepherd the transition."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "Manus is the one leading the reform movement. He must be the one to shepherd the transition."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "That decision is out of my hands. I'm sorry."

175.speaker: Player_Romus
175.text: "You realize that this would only be an interim position. That the people will soon vote for their new leader."

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "I can think of nobody more qualified. It would be an honor to have you fill that role."

177.speaker: Daria de Rava
177.text: "I would never move against you. But if one of the other houses got my relatives involved, I wouldn't be able to stop them."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "All right, I'm listening. Tell me what you want."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "We are done here. I highly suggest you leave this gathering immediately."

180.speaker: Player_Romus
180.text: "I appreciate your concern. But I neither need nor want any help from you."

182.speaker: Daria de Rava
182.text: "The man is good at getting people's attention. But what will happen once he has it? Does he realize actual leadership involves more than chanting and throwing rocks?"

184.speaker: Daria de Rava
184.text: "The nobles view him as a traitor, and he'll never truly be one of the common people. He may be a good figurehead now, but as a leader, can he keep Rizia together?"

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: She shook her head in disappointment.

186.speaker: Daria de Rava
186.text: "That may be so. But somebody's got to keep the kingdom from falling apart in the months leading to the new elections."

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: A smile spread across her face.

188.speaker: Daria de Rava
188.text: "Then I wish you the best of luck."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "I'm glad we could come to this agreement. And just so you know, I will act soon."

191.speaker: Player_Romus
191.text: "Sotelato is already compromising by agreeing to keep the monarchy in place. If I don't appoint him prime minister, there'll be hell to pay."

192.speaker: Daria de Rava
192.text: "We should get back out there before people start talking."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "The best I can do is try to get you a ministry position in the new government. Will you accept that?"

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "Your party lost the last elections. You're not the leader the people of Rizia want."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "Your party is only the majority because of a rigged electoral system. You're not the leader the people of Rizia want."

203.speaker: Player_Romus
203.text: "You're not in a position to be making demands, Ms. De Rava. I suggest you leave now."

205.speaker: Daria de Rava
205.text: "Hm. I remember a time when the King of Rizia didn't subjugate himself to the demands of coal miners."

210.speaker: Daria de Rava
210.text: "Can you promise me I'll have a proper say in decision-making? Nothing symbolic."
210.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseElections_RPPWinsSeats"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleOwnership_RiziaImperii"] == true)

217.speaker: Daria de Rava
217.text: "As Rizia's most powerful elected representative, this role should be mine by default."

218.speaker: Daria de Rava
218.text: "Rigged is in the eye of the beholder."

220.speaker: Daria de Rava
220.text: "I've spent half my life in service to Rizia Imperii and the Rizian Crown. Shouldn't that count for anything?"

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "Yes, and I'll make sure you still have a role to play in the Rizian government. Just not that of prime minister."

222.speaker: Narrator
222.text: She took another moment, then nodded.

223.speaker: Daria de Rava
223.text: "Then I will do what I can to make sure your plan succeeds."

224.speaker: Daria de Rava
224.text: "Then I really don't see the point in this conversation."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "If you want it that badly, it's yours. You'll just lose it in a few months anyway."

232.speaker: Narrator
232.text: A smile spread across her face.

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "I need these reforms to succeed more than anything. I'm willing to grant you the interim prime minister position if you help pacify the nobles."

234.speaker: Daria de Rava
234.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I will do what I can to make sure your plan succeeds."

235.speaker: Player_Romus
235.text: "It should be, I agree. But there is nothing I can do."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "Your entitlement is astounding. I suggest you leave this gathering before I have you booted out."

240.speaker: Narrator
240.text: She brushed past me and pushed open the doors to the trophy room.

241.speaker: Narrator
241.text: A few other guests watched in puzzlement as she picked up her coat and motioned for her husband to leave.

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "Talking about what? This conversation never happened."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "My final answer is no. I am sorry."

249.speaker: Player_Romus
249.text: "People will talk no matter what. You know how nobles are."

262.speaker: Daria de Rava
262.text: "He and everyone else knows there's nothing to be jealous of."

264.speaker: Estela Toras
264.text: "Darling, you know that small talk has solved more than one crisis among the Rizian royalty."

265.speaker: Estela Toras
265.text: "But go on, then. It's all the same to me."

269.speaker: Daria de Rava
269.text: "To be perfectly honest, I'm more afraid of the Queen Consort."

271.speaker: Narrator
271.text: We left the trophy room to rejoin the other guests. A few of them threw curious looks our way.

275.speaker: Narrator
275.text: We left the trophy room to rejoin the other guests. Manus threw a curious look our way.

278.speaker: Estela Toras
278.text: "It'll be ready for that when it's ready for democracy. Which is to say, not this century."

279.speaker: Estela Toras
279.text: "Too late for apologies now. You do make quite the fetching couple."

280.speaker: Estela Toras
280.text: "Your crown must be cutting off circulation to your brain if you believe that."

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "What do you mean, insincere? Everyone here loves you."

282.speaker: Player_Romus
282.text: "One more distant relative begging me for favors, and I would've joined you."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "Enough about that. Going public with my relationship was my decision to make."

288.speaker: Estela Toras
288.text: "No matter what our friends outside have to say about it."

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "I could tell you liked your presents."

293.speaker: Narrator
293.text: She lit one of Rusty's cigarettes, took a drag and exhaled with a sigh. Her other hand went to the pendant the Sazons had given her.

295.speaker: Estela Toras
295.text: "Ah, but doesn't it feel nice to be needed?"

296.speaker: Estela Toras
296.text: "Our guests' presents were wonderful. Their presence, on the other hand..."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "Personally, I'm very happy with how the evening went."

298.speaker: Estela Toras
298.text: "All three houses in the same room and not a drop of blood shed. You could say that counts as a success."

299.speaker: Narrator
299.text: She lit a cigarette, took a drag and exhaled with a sigh. Her other hand went to the pendant the Sazons had given her.

300.speaker: Narrator
300.text: Vina approached us with a frown.

303.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Azaro"] == true) == false

307.speaker: Vina Toras
307.text: "I've been listening to the talk around the library. It sounds like you got what you were hoping for."

308.speaker: Vina Toras
308.text: "I've been listening to the talk around the library. It sounds like the revolution's days are numbered."

312.speaker: Narrator
312.text: Vina approached us with a radiant smile.
312.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Azaro"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Vina_HeirApparent"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true)

313.speaker: Vina Toras
313.text: "It's been a great evening, wouldn't you say?"

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "Fantastic, isn't it? The entire Rizian nobility, working as one."

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "I had to make a lot of promises to a lot of people. I hope it was all worth it."

316.speaker: Player_Romus
316.text: "I hate the rebels for forcing us down this path of violence. If only they'd accepted a peaceful solution."

317.speaker: Player_Romus
317.text: "Indeed. As St. Wruhec wrote, 'Offer your enemies kindness, but never your submission."

321.speaker: Narrator
321.text: Vina approached us with a wary frown.
321.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Azaro"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Vina_HeirApparent"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Son_RespectTradition"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true)

322.speaker: Vina Toras
322.text: "You've done a lot of talking this evening, Father."

323.speaker: Narrator
323.text: Vina approached us with a smile.
323.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Sazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Toras"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Azaro"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Vina_HeirApparent"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Promised_Succession_Son_RespectTradition"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true)

324.speaker: Vina Toras
324.text: "You've been making the rounds? I hope it wasn't too exhausting."

328.speaker: Vina Toras
328.text: "We had a chance for peace. If only you'd listened to Manus--"

330.speaker: Vina Toras
330.text: "Violence is never worth it. If only you'd listened to Manus--"

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: She looked over at her husband. Manus nodded his assent.

339.speaker: Narrator
339.text: She looked over at her husband. He looked away guiltily.

341.speaker: Vina Toras
341.text: "But you never offered them kindness, did you? Only Manus did, and you never listened--"

345.speaker: Narrator
345.text: She stopped herself as her husband walked up to us.

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "It's my royal duty to converse with my subjects at these gatherings. Yours as well, I might add."

359.speaker: Narrator
359.text: Her husband walked up to us and slipped his arm through hers.

361.speaker: Estela Toras
361.text: "The reception after my wedding to your father -- now, that was a party. We were all so blotto, we didn't give a damn where the stars were."

362.speaker: Vina Toras
362.text: "I hope the Azaros had a good time, despite... never mind."

363.speaker: Vina Toras
363.text: "Good food, scintillating company, books everywhere -- what's not to like?"

367.speaker: Estela Toras
367.text: "Is the Party Prince calling it a night so soon?"

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "It's my royal duty to converse with my subjects at these gatherings. Yours as well, I might add."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "Are you kidding? I could do this all night."

370.speaker: Vina Toras
370.text: "I've been conversing. You yourself heard me."

374.speaker: Vina Toras
374.text: "I've been doing my best. But nobody here has anything interesting to say."

375.speaker: Vina Toras
375.text: "I'm done for, myself. Nobody here has anything interesting to say."

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "What about you? Did you find out any juicy gossip?"

382.speaker: Vina Toras
382.text: "One of the women who polishes the silverware caught her husband cheating on her. Other than that, nobody's got anything interesting to say."

383.speaker: Vina Toras
383.text: "Or at least, anything interesting to tell me..."

387.speaker: Axel Reinhart
387.text: "You throw a good soiree, Your Majesty. Though it would've been nothing without the lady of the hour."

388.speaker: Narrator
388.text: He kissed my mother's hand. She blushed.

389.speaker: Rico Toras
389.text: "Ten more minutes of formalities and we can get back to our lives, Your Highness."

394.speaker: Manus Sazon
394.text: "The Sazons thank you for your generosity, Your Majesty."

399.speaker: Vina Toras
399.text: "I wouldn't be in such a rush to leave, given what's waiting for us outside."

403.speaker: Narrator
403.text: He kept his tone light, but wore a worried expression.

404.speaker: Manus Sazon
404.text: "It's our hope to be invited back next year."

416.speaker: Narrator
416.text: Titus was standing nearby, his ear to his radio.
416.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Wedding_Happened"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true) == false)

420.speaker: Titus Gordion
420.text: "The front entrance is compromised, Your Majesty. Too many protesters in the square."

421.speaker: Titus Gordion
421.text: "The square is still clear of protesters, Your Majesty. We've readied the way for your guests' drivers to get through."

422.speaker: Titus Gordion
422.text: "We've readied the way for your guests' drivers to pull up to the back entrance."

424.speaker: Player_Romus
424.text: "I pray this is the last night we have to deal with this nonsense."

428.speaker: Player_Romus
428.text: "I take it nobody in the crowd's been injured?"

429.speaker: Player_Romus
429.text: "With luck, this is the last night we'll have to deal with this nonsense."

431.speaker: Titus Gordion
431.text: "We had to forcefully remove a few holdouts. But Nur be praised, no one was hurt."

435.speaker: Titus Gordion
435.text: "We had to forcefully remove a few holdouts. But no one was seriously hurt."

436.speaker: Titus Gordion
436.text: "It's for everybody's safety. Otherwise we'd never insist upon it."

437.speaker: Titus Gordion
437.text: "No matter what happens, my guards will make sure you and your loved ones are safe."

439.speaker: Narrator
439.text: Together with the rest of the Royal Family, I made my way to the back of the library.

443.speaker: Narrator
443.text: One by one, my noble guests said goodbye -- some with genuine warmth, others with fake smiles.

444.speaker: Narrator
444.text: Together with the rest of the Royal Family, I made my way back to the library foyer.
444.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Wedding_Happened"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.BirthdayGathering_Protests_AllowedOnSquare"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == true) == false)

445.speaker: Narrator
445.text: Every bow, handshake and subtle gesture a reminder of a promise made or broken, a bond forged or severed, an ally gained or lost.

446.speaker: Narrator
446.text: Who was still on my side? And would they stay there in the days and months to come?
